title: ModelRoleResource
description: Which provider and model serve one modality. Roles are modalities rather than performance tiers, so a tool that needs an image asks the runtime for the image role instead of carrying its own provider configuration.

model.description: Empty means the provider's own default model applies.

routed.description: False when no provider serves the role. Callers must treat this as capability unavailable rather than falling back to the default provider.

source.description: Where the binding came from: a stored assignment, daemon config, or nothing.
